material_text: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT INPUT. Candidate: Taylor Example. Worked as Documentation Volunteer at Lantern Learning Lab from January 2024 to June 2024. Taylor checked 12 workshop guides against facilitator notes and corrected broken section references. Taylor wrote a two-page setup checklist for the workshop laptops. The team used the checklist during one rehearsal; no time-saving outcome was measured. Taylor completed a BSc in Information Studies at Sample College, September 2020 to June 2023; degree awarded July 2023. Taylor uses Git and Markdown for document revisions. Hobby: sketching birds.
jd_text: SYNTHETIC JOB DESCRIPTION. A Technical Documentation Assistant checks guides, maintains clear setup instructions and tracks document revisions. Markdown experience is preferred. No employer or actual opening is represented.
